subject: Acme MAP: post-call recap & proposed Mutual Action Plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Summers <emily.summers@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:05 -0800
Subject: Acme MAP: post-call recap & proposed Mutual Action Plan

Hi Emily 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to propose an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please skim and flag any corrections.

Top pain points you called out
- High per-token cost on current vendor for real-time customer responses (esp. for tax and billing flows)
- Unpredictable tail latency during peak traffic windows causing timeouts and bad UX
- Security/compliance requirements: SOC 2 + KMS integration for PII data; audit logs needed for requests

Goals for Q11Q2
1) Reduce per-interaction inference cost by 30% while maintaining answer quality
2) Achieve p95 latency < 300ms for common query paths under expected load
3) Complete a security review with procurement + infra and confirm KMS approach

Proposed MAP (high-level milestones & owners)
- Feb 12: Technical demo + perf plan (Marissa + Redwood infra)  schedule 60m walkthrough (owner: Marissa)
- Feb 19: Pilot agreement & infra checklist completed (Acme infra + Redwood agmt)  owner: Jacob Lee (procurement) + Neha
- Mar 5: Pilot start  2-week pilot on dedicated staging capacity (owner: Acme engineering + Rishi)
- Mar 19: Pilot results review & decision point (metrics: cost delta, latency SLOs, quality evals)
- Apr 1: Contract finalization / initial ramp if pilot meets KPIs (owner: Jacob + Marissa)

Stakeholders we heard today
- Emily Summers  Product lead (decision influencer)
- Jacob Lee  Procurement (contract & SOC2 gating)  <-- added to cc for procurement visibility
- Sarah Nguyen  Engineering (pilot implementation)

Open questions / asks from Acme
- Any specific redlines you anticipate on standard MSA?
- Preferred timeline for security questionnaires (would you like SOC 2 evidence now or after pilot)?

Next steps
1) Can we lock the technical demo for Feb 12 at 10am PT? (I’ve proposed a 60m session.)
2) I’ve attached a starter MAP spreadsheet and the Redwood product sheet. We’ll use the sheet to capture dates and owners iteratively.

Thanks  looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-product-sheet.pdf (one-pager)

From: Emily Summers <emily.summers@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@acme.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: post-call recap & proposed Mutual Action Plan

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the quick recap and the MAP draft  this looks great and captures the conversation well. A few notes:

- Demo time: Feb 12 at 10am PT works for Product + Engineering on our side. I’ve added Sarah and myself to the meeting invite.
- Pilot timeline: we’d prefer the pilot kickoff target of Mar 1 (instead of Mar 5) if we can get staging access earlier. That would shift the results review to Mar 15. Can Redwood accommodate a Mar 1 start?
- Security evidence: Jacob, do you want SOC2 evidence up front? Jacob: (see below)

One small clarification on goals  for latency our p95 target is < 300ms for the top 80% of user queries; can we include that nuance in the MAP?

Thanks  Emily
